description: Perform a thorough, project-aware code review on the current PR and post it to GitHub as a real review with inline comments via the GitHub API. Use this skill whenever the user says "review", "review this PR", "review my changes", "do a code review", "give me feedback on this branch", or "check my PR" — especially when working in a git worktree. Trigger even if the user just says "review" with no other context.
